existingVersionedPublicBoundary.policy: ModelAdmissionPolicy.evaluate(ModelAdmissionInputV1): uses work.class, fresh quota observation, shared account ledger, unreflected upper-bound reservations and per-request expected five-hour/weekly percentages.
existingVersionedPublicBoundary.durableOwner: ModelAdmissionApi.reserve(ModelAdmissionRequestV1) returns ModelAdmissionRecordV1; the owner persists the work class and ModelAdmissionDecisionV1.reason/retryAt in toy_si.model_call.
existingVersionedPublicBoundary.databaseAndSeams: Existing disposable PostgreSQL ModelAdmission.withTest/accounting fixture is the real persistence boundary; virtual clock and fixed authorized/unavailable quota observations are the existing external seams. No mock internal collaborators or real provider call is needed.

selectedSmallestSourceUnit.actualCurrentBehavior: The policy has hard stops at 60% five-hour / 70% weekly, applies reservation risk, persists reason and retryAt, and pauses repair/replay when required windows are unavailable. For measured windows it currently applies the same projected 60/70 veto to every autonomous work class. It does not preserve tiered headroom by class when approaching the hard limits.
selectedSmallestSourceUnit.minimumBehavior: Add work-class preemption to the existing ModelAdmissionPolicy: preserve the canonical order repair/replay, then quiet-tick, then event/continuation as shared observations and outstanding reservations approach the hard ceilings. Keep foreground accepted. Persist each denied class with its durable decision reason and retryAt, and keep the stop limits fixed against the named windows rather than applying a percentage to the remaining allowance. Reuse ModelAdmissionInputV1, ModelAdmissionDecisionV1, and toy_si.model_call; no new DTO, module, service, database, or queue.
selectedSmallestSourceUnit.policyPrerequisite: Ops §13 names the 60%/70% hard ceilings and the required work-class order but gives no numeric headroom or fixed reservation amounts for the earlier stepwise pauses. No current behavior policy file supplies those tier amounts. The Ops policy owner must write the fixed tier boundary/reservation rule before implementation can select numeric cases; do not invent cutoffs in code or tests. Existing decision.retryAt is durable retry metadata, not proof that a separate Obligations wake was scheduled.
